arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. De Carli argued that reasonableness is the core of the Fourth Amendment. He criticized the lower court for creating a broad new rule.
Mr. Taylor argued that warrantless arrests for traffic offenders are reasonable. He stated that probable cause makes this intrusion lawful.
Mr. George stated that the Fourth Amendment issue includes the seizure. He emphasized the scope and nature of the seizure.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Gail Atwater sued the City of Lago Vista. She claims her arrest violated the Fourth Amendment. The city argues the arrest was lawful.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Atwater wants the Court to strike down the lower court rule. She seeks a ruling that her arrest was unreasonable.
The City of Lago Vista wants the Court to uphold the lower court decision. It seeks confirmation that its officers acted lawfully.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Atwater argues the lower court created a broad new rule. She contends this rule allows custodial arrests for any offense seen by an officer.
The City argues that warrantless arrests for traffic offenders are reasonable. It cites probable cause as the basis for this intrusion.
